### Headline summary
- Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia as CEO after President Trump reportedly intervened to reinstate him. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/jensen-huang-returns-to-nvidia-hq-im-terribly-sorry-2026-11), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261123/p37#a261123p37), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261123/p39#a261123p39), [NYT > Technology](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/us/politics/trump-nvidia-huang.html))
- Anthropic launched Claude Ship, a set of agents that can review, fix, and approve pull requests. ([The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/anthropic-claude-ship-approvals/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1040134/anthropic-claude-ship-ai-pull-requests))
- Oregon and Virginia sued Elon Musk's companies over weak safeguards against sexualized deepfakes. ([Artificial Intelligence Latest](https://www.wired.com/story/states-sue-spacex-over-grok-deepfakes/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2325111/two-states-sue-spacex-over-sexually-explicit-grok-deepfakes/))

### Shopify CEO says Jensen Huang's ouster was 'choreographed' and calls Nvidia board ‘knuckleheads’
Lütke blasted Nvidia board for Jensen Huang's rushed ouster. Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke said that Nvidia's Jensen Huang scandal felt choreographed. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/shopify-ceo-says-jensen-huangs-ouster-looked-choreographed-2026-11), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-23/nvidia-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-ceo-with-government-input), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/nvidia-reinstates-jensen-huang-ceo), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2324897/nvidia-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-ceo-and-president-effective-immediately/))

### Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia HQ to cheers: 'I'm going to be a better CEO the second time around'
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Bloomberg/Getty Images Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia HQ Monday to cheers and chants from employees. Huang apologized for the turmoil and vowed to be "a better CEO the second time around." Huang joked that he needed a new computer from IT on his first day back. ([Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/jensen-huang-returns-to-nvidia-hq-im-terribly-sorry-2026-11), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261123/p37#a261123p37))

### Sources: Trump pushed Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang after allies argued he was "too big to fail" for the US economy…
Axios : Sources: Trump pushed Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang after allies argued he was “too big to fail” for the US economy and a victim of “deep state” maneuvering — President Trump pushed Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO after allies argued he was “too big to fail” … ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261123/p39#a261123p39))

### Anthropic’s Claude Ship lets Claude approve routine pull requests
Anthropic on Monday launched Claude Ship , a set of three agents that can review pull requests (PRs), fix them, and approve them — if the team’s policy allows. The first of these three agents, Code Review , already became generally available in October. ([The New Stack](https://thenewstack.io/anthropic-claude-ship-approvals/))

### States Sue SpaceX Over Grok Deepfakes
The attorneys general of Oregon and Virginia are suing several of Elon Musk’s companies, alleging they implemented weak safeguards against sexualized imagery of real people, including children. ([Artificial Intelligence Latest](https://www.wired.com/story/states-sue-spacex-over-grok-deepfakes/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2325111/two-states-sue-spacex-over-sexually-explicit-grok-deepfakes/), [gHacks Technology News](https://www.ghacks.net/2026/11/23/oregon-and-virginia-sue-spacex-over-grok-sexual-deepfakes/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1040255/x-grok-ai-deepfakes-oregon-virginia-lawsuit))

### Sources: the Commerce Department plans to add Megaspeed to its entity list on Monday, barring US companies from selling…
Ashley Gold / Semafor : Sources: the Commerce Department plans to add Megaspeed to its entity list on Monday, barring US companies from selling chips to the company without a license — The Trump administration plans to add the company at the heart of the Nvidia scandal, Megaspeed, to a trade blackl… ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261123/p40#a261123p40))

### University Approves Nuclear Weapons Data Center, Township Vows to Fight On
Last week, the University of Michigan’s board of regents approved the construction of a $1.25 billion data center that will power American nuclear weapons research. The regents voted 7 - 1 in a public meeting on November 19 to move forward with the project despite widespread opposition from faculty… ([404 Media](https://www.404media.co/ypsilanti-michigan-data-center-vote/))

### NVIDIA's Jensen Huang will testify publicly before senators on December 3
It's going to be a busy few days in Washington DC for the freshly reinstated CEO. ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2325655/nvidia-jensen-huang-will-testify-publlicly-before-senators-on-december-3/))
